manual.title: Enter stations manually
manual.description: Enter the station IDs or URLs you want to monitor (comma-separated). You can also leave empty and add stations later. You can copy the URL from https://www.vigicrues.gouv.fr/

data_description.stations: List of station IDs or URLs separated by commas. Leave empty to configure later. Example: {stations_example}

search.title: Search for stations
search.description: Search by place or watercourse name. Only active stations are shown.

select_stations.title: Select stations
select_stations.description: Choose one or more stations. Some Hub'Eau stations may not be available in Vigicrues.

error.search_unavailable: Cannot connect to the Hub'Eau search service
error.search_required: Enter a place or watercourse name
error.no_stations_found: No active stations found. Try another search term or enter a station ID manually.
error.station_unavailable: One or more selected stations are unavailable in Vigicrues. Change your selection.

init.title: Modify Vigicrues Configuration
init.description: Modify the station IDs or URLs you want to monitor (comma-separated). Leave empty to remove all stations.

data_description.stations: List of station IDs or URLs separated by commas. Leave empty to remove all stations. Example: {stations_example}
